description:
A blazing fast ultra-light photo viewer replacement for Windows. Works similar to Picasa Photo Viewer.

Fly Photos is one of the fastest photo viewers for Windows, designed as a modern replacement for the now-discontinued Google Picasa Photo Viewer. Built with WinUI 3, WinRT, and Win2D, it delivers smooth animations, instant startup, and an efficient viewing experience.
❤️ Support FlyPhotos' development by sponsoring or by downloading from Microsoft Store
✨ New Features & Improvements
- Rename the current photo with F2. (#204)
- Customizable keyboard shortcuts. New Shortcuts tab in Settings. (#209)
- Mouse now has its own Settings tab. (#209)
- Custom window background - pick any color with a color picker. (#235)
- Photo Info panel now reads DDS texture details - dimensions, format, texture type, mipmap count and alpha mode, with the raw header fields under Show All. (#231)
- Multi-frame ICO files open like a multi-page image - page through every frame with the existing multi-page controls, largest resolution first. (#223)
- Explorer right-click menu now follows the Windows light/dark setting. (#222)
- The bottom panel's auto-hide hot zone is now sized to the panel itself instead of a fixed 30% of the screen height. (#216)
- EXIF info panel remembers its view mode (Summary / Show All).
🐞 Bug Fixes
- Fixed photos opening in the wrong order when launched from Explorer. (#228)
- Fixed WebP and other files under 16 KB failing to load from SMB/network drives with "Invalid File". Network reads are faster too. (#215)
- Fixed mouse wheel navigation showing a low-res frame before high-res even when the photo was already in the high-res cache. (#213)
❓ FAQ
Got questions, or running into an issue? Please check out our Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) page for quick answers and troubleshooting steps.
Thanks to everyone who reported issues and suggested improvements. Looking forward to your feedback on this release.
